name: Gouda Studios Agent Tools
description: Agent-payable public records data tools (SAM.gov, SEC EDGAR, USAspending, GLEIF) via Apify's hosted MCP server.

tools.name: gouda_studios/sam-gov-opportunities-feed
tools.description: Get new federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov as clean JSON, no API key needed. Filter by keyword, NAICS, set-aside, notice type, agency and state. Includes deadlines, days left and contracting officer contacts. Monitor mode returns only new notices.

tools.name: gouda_studios/sec-edgar-filings-feed
tools.description: Monitor SEC EDGAR filings by ticker or CIK, including 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, Form 4 insider trades, Form D and S-1. Each result has the company, form type, filing date and document links. Only-new mode turns it into an alert feed for investors, research and AI agents.

tools.name: gouda_studios/usaspending-awards-search
tools.description: Search USAspending.gov federal awards by keyword, recipient, agency, NAICS, state, date and amount. Get contracts and grants with amounts, recipients, awarding agency and performance dates as JSON. Track competitors, find who won contracts and build sales prospect lists.

tools.name: gouda_studios/gleif-company-lei-lookup
tools.description: Find any company LEI number by name, or look up an LEI, in the official GLEIF global registry. Get the legal name, status, jurisdiction, registration number, legal and HQ address, and direct and ultimate parent companies. For KYC, KYB, vendor checks and data enrichment.
